title: LA Peptides Product Profile
description: One specific product/batch's content — peptide identity, claims, and tracking data. Changes far more often than a brand-profile.json (a new batch = a new product-profile.json; a brand partner's identity/styling stays the same across many of these). Combines with a brand-profile.json to render a finished label — see RENDERING-SPEC.md. Every property maps to a specific master-label.svg element id; the exact mapping is implemented in scripts/lib/composeProfiles.js and is 1:1 with label-spec.json's field registry.

productProfileId.description: Stable identifier for this product/batch, e.g. "tesamorelin-10mg-lot-ex010125".

peptideName.description: -> product_name (autofit: shrinks to fit if needed, see VALIDATION-RULES.md).

descriptor.description: Optional short descriptor, e.g. "PURE PEPTIDE". -> product_descriptor.

ubd.description: Use-by date as MM/YYYY, e.g. "06/2026". -> ubd.

coaQrDestination.description: URL encoded into the QR code (typically a COA lookup page for this exact batch). Required even if coaUrl is also set — they are not assumed to be the same string. -> coa_qr (generates a real, scannable QR at build time).

coaUrl.description: Optional human-readable URL printed as text in addition to the QR. Defaults to coaQrDestination with the scheme stripped if omitted. -> coa_url. Fixed-width column, does not auto-shrink.

qrCaption.description: Optional; overrides the brand-profile's qrStyle.caption for this product only. -> qr_caption.

productCategory.description: Optional classification (e.g. "PEPTIDE", "BLEND", "CAPSULE") for downstream systems — admin portal filtering, inventory, reporting. NOT currently bound to a visual element: this label format's 0.77in-tall layout has no remaining safe space for another visible field (see VALIDATION-RULES.md). Captured here so profile data stays forward-compatible with a future layout revision that does render it — composeProfiles.js does not map this to any fieldKey today.
